channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Welcome to the 'upper-middle-class trap': why $300,000 a year doesn't feel like winning anymore
item.description: Investopedia puts a $5 million price tag on the American Dream, but Nick Maggiulli says six-figure earners are more financially fragile than they appear.

item.title: 'Clearly, people hate data centers': Sam Altman admits Americans hate what he's wrought as his own data centers head quits
item.description: Seven in 10 Americans oppose an AI data center near them, even as OpenAI adds multi-gigawatt projects across the U.S.

item.title: OpenAI bans pro-Russia ChatGPT accounts used to spread pro-Kremlin content including an Israel-based think tank using real researchers' names
item.description: OpenAI claims Russian users hid behind VPNs to push a think tank tied to an influence operation and spread pro-Russia content online.

item.title: The AI Odyssey: Ancient Greek fear revived by modern technology
item.description: Long before chatbots, Greek philosophy addressed the anxiety shaping 2026. We are all Odysseus, navigating the sirens' call...
